card.name: Article before inhibitor or substrate in interaction text
card.fires_on: The words a or an (sometimes an adjective like reversible) right after 'drug X is' in drug-interaction text. The next word is expected to be inhibitor or substrate of an enzyme or transporter.

modes.label: Drug is a/an
modes.description: The article after 'is' when a named drug is described as an inhibitor or substrate of a CYP enzyme or transporter.
modes.example: In vitro studies have shown that gemfibrozil is<< an>> inhibitor of CYP1A2,

modes.label: Adjective after a
modes.description: An adjective such as reversible placed before inhibitor.
modes.example: In vitro data demonstrated that armodafinil is a<< reversible>> inhibitor of CYP2C19

card.writes: It suggests the next word is a role noun like inhibitor or substrate, and it lowers 'activity' words.
card.plain: It fires on 'a' or 'an' in lines saying a drug is an inhibitor or substrate of a liver enzyme or transporter.
